claim: An agent release event does not clear an atomic queue claim row; release a stuck claim through the claimant-path fail-and-requeue under documented operator authorization, then complete with evidence.

decisions.notes: A release event left the task claimed; the sanctioned fail path requeued it (retry one of three) and the replacement claimant completed it with the qualification evidence.
